_comment: Per-voice / per-reflection audio treatment for the dedicated 4-7 kid lane. Calibrated by ear on a Bluetooth speaker (Adam, 2026-06-16). Read by scripts/kid_audio_flags.py, which scripts/compress_audio.sh uses to reproduce the published mirror. See docs/AUDIO_LOUDNESS.md.
_rationale: All kid audio gets an 80 Hz high-pass (de-plosive). Warm-voiced narrators bloom in the low-mids and read 'loud' on bass-boosting speakers, so every voice EXCEPT the bright 'good' ones gets a 250 Hz de-bloom. Stories normalize to -18; reflections (short, flat, forward v3) sit lower so they don't read louder than the story.
